attributes.action: Ban the public sale of fireworks and restrict displays to pre-approved events
attributes.additional_details: Current firework regulations fail to protect pets, livestock, and vulnerable individuals from sudden, unpredictable distress. We want the government to change the law so that fireworks can no longer be bought by the public. Instead, fireworks should only be permitted at events that have been formally reviewed and approved by the local council. Furthermore, organizers must be legally required to alert the affected public in advance so communities can prepare and protect their animals.
attributes.background: We call on the government to ban the retail sale of fireworks to the general public, and require that all firework displays be officially approved by local councils with mandatory public notification.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
